summary: Pinned curl 7.76.1-40.el9 on node1 using DNF versionlock. A newer curl build is available, but DNF schedules no upgrade. The lock persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Verified DNF leaves curl unchanged despite version 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 being available.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed curl remains installed, executable, and locked after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: The version lock targets curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*. Although 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 is available, `dnf upgrade --assumeno curl` reports nothing to do before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 was captured, the reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID c35631c3-24a1-40cb-bc29-d6860e429ba1. Post-restart checks confirmed curl 7.76.1-40.el9, the plugin, persistent lock, working curl binary, and blocked upgrade.
